name: yajsv
description: JSON schema validator - validate JSON documents against JSON Schema

yajsv.description: Yet Another JSON Schema Validator - fast and simple JSON Schema validation tool
yajsv.usage:
yajsv -s schema.json data.json
yajsv -s schema.json data1.json data2.json
echo '{"name":"test"}' | yajsv -s schema.json
